name: Muscle-Up Clean Ladder

origin.summary: An event from the 2017 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: Eight rounds of bar muscle-ups and heavy cleans.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2017/9 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; clean load increases each round: 225-245-265-285-305-320-335-350 lb (men), 145-160-175-190-205-215-225-235 lb (women)
